clips.send: Einstein’s general relativity says mass curves spacetime, and objects follow those curves: that is gravity. Picture a stretchy sheet: put a heavy ball on it and it sags, so marbles rolling past curve around it. clips.send: The Sun. A normal star: a gentle dip. The Sun is 1.4 million km (870,000 miles) wide and holds 99.8 percent of the Solar System’s mass. Its gravity curves spacetime gently: the planets roll around the dip in orbits. To escape from its surface you need 618 km/s, only 0.2 percent of the speed of light. The Sun will never become a black hole: it isn’t massive enough. It will end as a white dwarf. Same mass, bigger size, gentler dip.

clips.send: Black hole (Cygnus X-1). About 21 Suns inside a 62-km horizon. Cygnus X-1 was the first object widely accepted as a black hole (1970s). It is about 7,000 light-years away. Its event horizon has a radius of about 62 km (39 miles). At the event horizon the escape speed equals the speed of light, so nothing inside can get out, not even light. We “see” it because gas pulled from its companion star heats up to millions of degrees and glows in X-rays. Event horizon equals the point of no return.

clips.send: Two black holes circling each other lose energy as gravitational waves, so they spiral closer and faster until they merge into one. As a wave passes, it stretches space one way and squeezes it the other. LIGO measures that stretch with laser “rulers” 4 km long, detecting changes far smaller than a proton. The signal, rising in both pitch and strength, is called a chirp.

clips.send: 两个互相绕转的黑洞会以引力波的形式不断辐射能量，于是越转越近、越转越快，最后合并成一个黑洞。引力波经过时，会把空间在一个方向上拉长、另一个方向上压缩。LIGO 用 4 千米长的激光“尺子”测量这种比质子还小得多的伸缩。频率和强度一起升高的信号叫“啁啾”。

clips.send: 爱因斯坦的广义相对论说：质量会让时空弯曲，物体沿着弯曲的时空运动，这就是引力。用一张弹性膜来想象：放一个重球，膜就会凹下去，滚过的弹珠会绕着它转。把同样的质量压得越小，凹坑就越深，最后会出现一个连光都逃不出的“洞”。

clips.send: 黑洞（天鹅座 X-1）。约 21 个太阳的质量，藏在半径 62 千米的视界里。天鹅座 X-1 是第一个被普遍承认的黑洞（20 世纪 70 年代），距离我们约 7000 光年。它的事件视界半径约 62 千米（39 英里）。在事件视界处，逃逸速度等于光速，所以里面的任何东西都出不来，连光也不行。我们能“看到”它，是因为从伴星被拉过来的气体被加热到几百万度，发出 X 射线。事件视界 等于 有去无回的边界。
